def add_product_to_csv(event, claim, price, status):

    file_path = "products.csv"
    
    # Read existing products to determine next ID
    next_id = 1
    if os.path.exists(file_path):
        with open(file_path, 'r') as file:
            reader = csv.reader(file)
            rows = list(reader)
            if len(rows) > 1:  # Header + at least one product
                # Get the last product ID and increment
                last_row = rows[-1]
                if last_row and last_row[0].isdigit():

    # Create the product name by combining event and claim
    product_name = f"{event} {claim}"
    
    # Add the new product

        writer = csv.writer(file)
        writer.writerow([next_id, product_name, price, status])
    
    print(f"Added product: ID={next_id}, Name='{product_name}', Price={price}, Status={status}")
